items.source: Called after a session's tool index has been cleared — either because this strategy returned it from onAccess(String), or because of an explicit eviction request.
items.translation: 在会话的工具索引被清除后调用——无论是因为该策略通过onAccess(String)返回了它，还是因为显式的驱逐请求。

items.source: Called each time a session is accessed at the start of request processing.
items.translation: 每次在请求处理开始时访问会话时都会调用。

items.source: onAccess(String) is called at the start of every request. Any session IDs it returns are cleared from the ToolIndex, after which onRemoved(String) is called so the strategy can drop its own internal tracking state.
items.translation: onAccess(String) 会在每个请求开始时被调用。它返回的任何会话 ID 都将从 ToolIndex 中清除，随后会调用 onRemoved(String)，以便该策略能够清理其内部跟踪状态。

items.source: Implementations should update their internal tracking state for sessionId and return the set of session IDs whose tool indexes must now be cleared. The returned set must never include the currently-accessed sessionId.
items.translation: 实现应更新其内部跟踪状态以处理sessionId，并返回必须清除工具索引的会话 ID 集合。该返回集合绝不能包含当前正在访问的sessionId。

items.source:
Common strategies include: never evicting (indexes persist until explicitly removed),
always evicting (fresh re-index on every request), LRU eviction (cap on active session
count), TTL eviction (idle sessions expire after a configured duration), and composite
eviction (union of multiple strategies).
items.translation: 常见策略包括：永不驱逐（索引在显式删除前一直保留）、总是驱逐（每次请求时重新建立索引）、LRU 驱逐（限制活跃会话数量）、TTL 驱逐（空闲会话在配置时长后过期），以及复合驱逐（多种策略的组合）。

items.source: Implementations should remove any internal tracking state for the evicted session.
items.translation: 实现应移除被驱逐会话的任何内部跟踪状态。

items.source: session IDs to evict; never null, may be empty
items.translation: 待驱逐的会话 ID；永远不会为null，可能为空。

items.source: Strategy that decides which session tool indexes should be evicted.
items.translation: 决定应驱逐哪些会话工具索引的策略。
